quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #23
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, what should happen?

options.text: The largest vehicle has the right-of-way.
The car on the left has the right-of-way.
The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at the same time at an uncontrolled intersection, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The driver on the left can go when it is safe.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which way should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: Keep the front wheels straight.
In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
Opposite to the direction of the skid.
In any direction. It doesn't matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
questions.explanation: Turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the vehicle to go. Once the vehicle straightens out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pull out to pass.
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road.
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing a bicycle because the cyclist may need to swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road. Always drive carefully near cyclists.

questions.question: Your vehicle is blocking traffic after an accident. What should you do?

options.text: Move your vehicle off the road if possible.
Do not move your vehicle under any circumstances.
Wait for the police to arrive before moving your vehicle.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle off the road if possible.
questions.explanation: After a minor accident, move your vehicle off the road if you can. Do not leave the accident scene without identifying yourself and helping if needed.

questions.question: How much can front door windows be tinted?

options.text: 100 percent light blockage.
Whatever looks good.
65 percent light blockage.
50 percent light blockage.

questions.correctAnswerText: 65 percent light blockage.
questions.explanation: You can tint side and rear windows. Front door windows can only be tinted up to 65 percent light blockage.

questions.question: When should you slow down when exiting a highway?

options.text: On the main road, just before the exit lane.
Once you see a toll booth.
After you have moved into the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you have moved into the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Get into the exit lane well in advance. Do not slow down until after you have moved into the exit lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a complete stop, then go when safe.
Go carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop and let vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a speed restriction sign show?

options.text: Can be ignored in rain, snow, or ice.
Has a triangular shape.
Is blue with black lettering.
A recommended speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: A recommended speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: Speed signs on curves and turns show a recommended speed for those areas. While you might feel comfortable going faster in good weather, never exceed the recommended speed in rain, snow, or ice.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people.
Specific turns are allowed from specific lanes.
Do not enter.
Both lanes should merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are only for buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Railroad crossing.
One-way traffic.
Limited parking.
Playground ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn you of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What is a slow-moving vehicle emblem?

options.text: A rectangular red sign.
A circular green sign.
A diamond-shaped yellow sign.
A triangular orange sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A triangular orange sign.
questions.explanation: The slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this emblem travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: Which does NOT help with safe night driving?

options.text: Keep your windshield clean.
Know that tinted windows reduce visibility in the dark.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: Looking into oncoming headlights narrows your pupils. When the vehicle passes, your pupils take time to adjust to darker light. During this adjustment, you cannot see well.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow mean?

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a yellow traffic light.
It means you can turn in the direction of the arrow.
It warns that a green arrow is coming soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a yellow traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same as a yellow traffic light. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) does NOT depend on:

options.text: Your body weight.
How much you drink.
How much time passes between drinks.
How physically fit you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are.
questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much you drink, time between drinks, and your weight. Physical fitness and how well you handle alcohol do not affect BAC.

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection blocked by traffic?

options.text: Go slowly until traffic ahead moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front.
Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through completely.
Use your horn to make cars move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through completely.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if you cannot drive all the way through. Wait for traffic to clear so you do not block the intersection.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, which way should you turn your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.
Keep your wheels straight.
Leave your transmission in neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: When parking downhill, turn your wheels sharply toward the road edge. If your car rolls, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means you can pass only from the side with the broken line.

questions.question: When must you pull over for an emergency vehicle?

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from.
Only if it is behind you.
Only if it is coming toward you.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from.
questions.explanation: Always pull over to the right edge and stop for an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, whether it is behind you or approaching from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What can you do on a highway with double solid yellow lines?

options.text: Cross them only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
Cross them to pass other cars if no traffic is coming.
Never cross them.
Cross them only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross them only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You may only cross them to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: What is the first step when parallel parking between two cars?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull up even with the car in front of the parking space.
Back slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up even with the car in front of the parking space.
questions.explanation: First, check traffic and signal. Then stop alongside the car in front of the parking space before turning your wheels to park.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show drivers directions and distances.

options.text: Yellow
Red
Green
White

questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background. They show directions and distances to places. They help drivers who are driving in new areas.

questions.question: Regulatory signs:

options.text: Are placed in every location where there is danger.
Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
Are diamond-shaped and yellow or green.
May warn drivers that a school zone is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular, white, and have black markings. They tell drivers what to do and what not to do in an area. They show speed limits, no passing zones, no turning signs, and other driving rules.

questions.question: What should you adjust first when you get into a car to drive?

options.text: Your seat belt
The steering wheel
Your rearview mirror
Your seat

questions.correctAnswerText: Your seat
questions.explanation: First, adjust your seat so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. After your seat is set, adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: You come to an intersection with a flashing red light. You must:

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left because the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. After you stop, you can go when it is safe and traffic allows.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. This signal means the driver plans to:

options.text: Turn left.
Turn right.
Stop.
Go straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn right.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Change your driving if you see this signal.
